item.text:
**Assessment:** mostly no. I found repeated evidence of politicized security structures, delegitimizing rhetoric toward oversight, and repression of journalists, opposition figures, and civil-society monitors. I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Abiy deliberately avoided personality-cult dynamics or party/state capture.

**Accepted claims**
- **Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-02 | [link](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups) | HRW says the government suspended three rights groups while Abiy praised reforms such as media freedom and NGO registration. That is evidence of selective punishment of independent monitors, not of avoiding politicization of neutral oversight institutions. | `4B.5`, `4B.4`, `3B.8`, `4B.3`
- **The state-of-emergency proclamation** | ENA English | 2024-11-03 | [link](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_30124) | The proclamation centralized coercive authority, empowered an operation command, restricted CSOs and media suspected of helping “terrorist” groups, imposed ID/movement controls, and suspended normal judicial handling of enforcement. This reads like executive capture of neutral institutions, not insulation from politicization. | `4B.5`, `4B.4`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`, `4B.2`
- **In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels** | Reuters via EHRC | 2024-02-27 | [link](https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/) | Reuters reported a secret security committee in Oromia that interfered in the justice system and was linked to widespread human-rights violations. That is strong evidence of covert, politically shielded security governance rather than neutral state administration. | `4B.5`, `4B.4`, `3B.9`, `4B.2`
- **World Report 2024: Ethiopia** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-12 | [link](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/ethiopia) | HRW said authorities restricted social media, arrested opposition figures and journalists, and used emergency powers in ways that narrowed political space. This supports a pattern of politicizing state power against critics instead of keeping institutions neutral. | `4B.5`, `4B.3`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`, `4B.4`
- **Ethiopia’s Deepening Crackdown on Dissent** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-03-04 | [link](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/04/ethiopias-deepening-crackdown-dissent) | HRW reported the detention of an opposition spokesperson and a journalist, plus broad arbitrary detention under emergency powers. That is direct evidence of intimidation and coercive politicization, not neutral institutional behavior. | `4B.5`, `4B.3`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`, `4B.4`
- **Ethiopia: Journalist arrested under state of emergency: Belay Manaye** | Amnesty International | 2024-03-14 | [link](https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/afr25/7782/2024/en/) | Amnesty said a journalist was detained under emergency powers for reporting on the Amhara conflict, and that other journalists had also been arbitrarily arrested. This is evidence that state power was used to intimidate critical media rather than remain neutral. | `4B.5`, `4B.3`, `3B.8`, `3B.9`
- **Ethiopia - CIVICUS Monitor** | CIVICUS Monitor | 2024-12-04 | [link](https://monitor.civicus.org/press_release/2024/ethiopia/) | CIVICUS downgraded Ethiopia’s civic space to “Closed,” citing surveillance, harassment, intimidation, and threats against journalists and opposition members. That is incompatible with avoiding intimidation or politicization of state institutions. | `4B.5`, `4B.3`, `3B.8`
- **Abiy says rights body hijacked by foreigners** | AFP via EWN | 2024-07-04 | [link](https://www.ewn.co.za/2024/07/04/ethiopias-abiy-says-rights-body-hijacked-by-foreigners) | Abiy’s claim that human-rights institutions were being “hijacked” by foreigners is delegitimizing rhetoric aimed at independent oversight. It suggests politicization of oversight bodies rather than respect for institutional neutrality. | `4B.5`, `4B.4`, `3B.8`
- **Actors of Protection Ethiopia - February 2024** | GOV.UK | 2024-01-12 | [link](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/ethiopia-country-policy-and-information-notes/country-policy-and-information-note-actors-of-protection-ethiopia-february-2024-accessible) | The note says the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission receives complaints and that some state/federal institutions implemented its recommendations on human-rights protections and prison conditions. This is weak positive evidence of some complaint-handling capacity, but it does not show insulation from executive politicization. | `4B.5`, `4B.4`, `3B.9`
- **Ethiopia transitional justice policy launch** | ENA English | 2024-12-14 | [link](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5626876) | The justice minister said the transitional-justice policy covers accountability, truth-seeking, conditional amnesty, reconciliation, and institutional reform after consultations with civil society and vulnerable groups. This is the strongest weak-positive institutional claim, but it is still a roadmap, not proof that Abiy avoided party capture or politicization in practice. | `4B.5`, `4B.4`, `3B.9`, `3B.8`

**Search gap**
- I did not find a strong 2024 source showing Abiy explicitly avoided personality cult behavior or imposed anti-loyalty-test rules inside the ruling party/state.
- The positive evidence is mostly procedural or aspirational, while the negative evidence is operational and repeated.
